events.title: Alan Shearer adds another hat-trick for 블랙번 로버스 in their 4–2 home win over 웨스트햄 유나이티드 in the league. 입스위치 타운 give their survival hopes a boost with a 4–1 home win over fellow strugglers 레스터 시티.
맨체스터 유나이티드 get their title push back on track after back-to-back draws by beating 코번트리 시티 2–0 at Old Trafford.
애스턴 빌라 sign striker Tommy Johnson and defender Gary Charles from 더비 카운티 for £1.45million each.

Division Three 월솔 hold Premier League 리즈 유나이티드 to a 1–1 draw the Bescot Stadium in the FA Cup third round to force a replay . Enfield 's hopes of achieving an upset against 레스터 시티 are ended when they lose 2–0 to the home side at Filbert Street . Marlow's FA Cup dream ends in a 2–0 defeat at 스윈던 타운. 렉섬 shock 입스위치 타운 2–0, while Aylesbury United 's run ends in a 4–0 defeat by 퀸스 파크 레인저스 at Loftus Road . 버밍엄 시티 hold 리버풀 to a goalless draw. Last season's beaten finalists 첼시 beat Charlton 3–0 at Stamford Bridge.
체스터 시티 sack manager Mike Pejic, with the club having lost 17 of their 24 games this season and being ten points adrift of safety. Physiotherapist Derek Mann is appointed as caretaker manager.
맨체스터 유나이티드 meet 셰필드 유나이티드 in the FA Cup at Bramall Lane for the second season running, and triumph 2–0.
맨체스터 유나이티드 break the English transfer fee record by signing Andy Cole from 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 in a deal worth £7million; £6million cash plus £1million-rated winger Keith Gillespie , 19.
에버턴 are reported to be in the process of making a £2.5million bid for 31-year-old 맨체스터 유나이티드 striker 마크 휴스 , whose future at Old Trafford has been threatened by the arrival of Andy Cole.
Howard Kendall makes his return to management with Division One's basement side 노츠 카운티, who have been under the management of Russell Slade since early September.
아스널 pay 루턴 타운 £2.5million for 19-year-old Welsh striker John Hartson .
입스위치 타운 collect three priceless points in a shock 1–0 win over 리버풀 at Anfield, in which 21-year-old winger Adam Tanner scores the only goal.

마크 휴스 suffers a knee injury as he scored 맨체스터 유나이티드's goal in their 1–1 league draw at 뉴캐슬 유나이티드. It is feared that he has suffered cruciate ligament damage and will be out of action until next season, effectively ending 에버턴's hopes of signing him any time soon. 맨체스터 유나이티드's new signing Andy Cole does not play in the match, nor does Keith Gillespie, who went into the opposite direction as part of the deal. United are now five points behind leaders 블랙번 로버스, who have a game in hand.
Tests show that the knee injury suffered by 마크 휴스 yesterday is less serious than feared, and he is expected to return to action before the end of next month.
월솔's FA Cup dream is ended in a 5–2 defeat by 리즈 유나이티드 at Elland Road in the third round replay.
밀월 beat 아스널 2–0 in the FA Cup third round replay at Highbury.

Guus Hiddink makes his debut as the manager of Netherlands national team with a friendly loss (0–1) against France . Two players make their debut as well: strikers Michael Mols ( 트벤터 ) and Glenn Helder ( 피테서 ).
Dutch club FC Zwolle names former goalkeeper Piet Schrijvers as their new manager to replace Ben Hendriks.
Steve Nicol , 리버풀's longest serving player, joins 노츠 카운티 on a free transfer after 13 years at Anfield .

리즈 유나이티드 pay a club record £3.4million for 프랑크푸르트 's Ghanaian striker 토니 예보아 . 에버턴 climb out of the relegation zone again with a 3–1 home win over 크리스털 팰리스. 볼턴 원더러스 , who have been outside the top flight since 1980, beat Charlton 5–1 at Burnden Park to move just two points short of top position in Division One. The club also have a new all-seater stadium at Lostock in the pipeline which is hoped to be open by the 1997–98 season, as well as being in this season's League Cup semi-final.

블랙번 로버스 are now just one point ahead of 맨체스터 유나이티드 at the top of the Premier League after 알렉스 퍼거슨's men beat them 1–0 at Old Trafford with 에리크 캉토나's 12th league goal of the season. Andy Cole makes his United debut in the game.
칸토나의 관중 가격 사건 — 맨유와 크리스털 팰리스의 경기에서 에리크 칸토나가 관중을 가격했다. 현장의 행동과 이후 내려진 징계·법적 판단은 서로 다른 시점의 정보다.

에리크 캉토나 , in an away match against 크리스털 팰리스 , he launched a ' kung-fu ' style kick against an abusive 크리스털 팰리스 fan, Matthew Simmons, after being sent off by the referee for a tackle on Palace defender Richard Shaw . He then got up from his seat and left, leaving many of the assembled crowd bemused. One month later, he was sentenced to 120 hours of community service after an appeal court overturned a 2-week prison sentence for assault . He was also suspended by The Football Association until the following October.

After being sent off for kicking an opponent in 맨체스터 유나이티드's 1–1 draw at 크리스털 팰리스, 에리크 캉토나 leaps into the crowd and kicks spectator Matthew Simmons, who had allegedly been making racist remarks to the Frenchman. Jurgen Klinsmann is carried off in 토트넘 홋스퍼's 1–0 defeat at 애스턴 빌라 in a collision with goalkeeper Mark Bosnich .
블랙번 로버스 beat 입스위치 타운 4–1 in the league at Ewood Park, with Alan Shearer scoring yet another hat-trick.
맨체스터 유나이티드 confirm that 에리크 캉토나 will not play for the first team for the rest of the season, and fine him £20,000 after being charged with bringing the game into disrepute.

In the first game after the 에리크 캉토나 incident, 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 렉섬 5–2 in the FA Cup fourth round at Old Trafford . Brian Flynn 's Division Two underdogs gave United a scare after taking an early lead, but United soon blew them apart.
Brian Little continues his reshaping of the 애스턴 빌라 squad with the £1.7million sale of defender Earl Barrett to 에버턴.

The month ends with 블랙번 로버스 still leading the Premier League, while 맨체스터 유나이티드 have cut their lead to a single point 케니 달글리시 's men have a two-game advantage of their Old Trafford rivals. 리버풀, 노팅엄 포리스트 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 complete the top five. 입스위치 타운 and 레스터 시티 continue to prop up the top flight, while 애스턴 빌라 and 에버턴 have surged clear of the drop zone at the expense of 코번트리 시티 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드. 미들즈브러 are now two points ahead of 울버햄프턴 원더러스 (who are level with 볼턴 원더러스) at the top of Division One, with Reading and 트랜미어 로버스 completing the top five.
